patch.title: Star Wars Outlaws Gold Edition
patch.description_ar: عِش مغامرة خارج عن القانون في عالم Star Wars مع Kay Vess ورفيقها Nix. يضم الإصدار الذهبي اللعبة الأساسية وحزمة الموسم، بما فيها قصتا Wild Card وA Pirate’s Fortune ومهمة Jabba’s Gambit وحزم الشخصيات والمظاهر المذكورة في صفحة Nintendo الرسمية.
patch.description_short: مغامرة عالم مفتوح على Nintendo Switch 2 تضم اللعبة الأساسية وحزمة الموسم كاملة.
patch.tagline: Live the high-stakes life of an outlaw across the Star Wars underworld.
features: Touch controls for menus and selected minigames
Both Wild Card and A Pirate’s Fortune story packs
fitFor: Players who want a single-player open-world Star Wars adventure
Players who enjoy stealth, blaster combat, exploration, and faction choices
Players who want the complete Gold Edition package on Switch 2
notFitFor: Players looking for multiplayer or local co-op
Players who cannot download the physical Game-Key Card installation
Players expecting a locked 60 FPS performance mode

gameplayPillars.title: Scoundrel freedom
gameplayPillars.description: Use stealth, blasters, gadgets, and Nix to approach dangerous jobs.

gameplayPillars.title: Syndicate reputation
gameplayPillars.description: Choices and contracts affect Kay’s standing with criminal factions.

gameplayPillars.title: Planetary exploration
gameplayPillars.description: Travel through cities, cantinas, wilderness, and space aboard the Trailblazer.

gameplayPillars.title: Gold Edition content
gameplayPillars.description: Includes both official story packs and the Season Pass bonus content listed by Nintendo.

patch.worldSummary: Kay Vess and Nix cross the galactic underworld while building a crew, navigating rival syndicates, and preparing a major heist.

faq.q: What edition is this?
faq.a: This is the Gold Edition; it includes the base game and the Season Pass content listed by Nintendo.

faq.q: Does it support multiplayer?
faq.a: No. Nintendo lists one player and the game is a single-player adventure.

faq.q: What is the official Switch 2 frame-rate target?
faq.a: Ubisoft states a target of up to 30 FPS in both TV and handheld modes; no exact rendering resolution is published.

faq.q: Does the physical copy contain the full game on the card?
faq.a: No. Ubisoft confirms it is a Nintendo Game-Key Card and requires an internet download for installation.

faq.q: Can progress move from another platform?
faq.a: Yes. Ubisoft confirms cross-progression through Ubisoft Connect.

patch.title: Dead by Daylight
patch.description_ar: لعبة رعب جماعية غير متناظرة عبر الإنترنت: أربعة ناجين يحاولون إصلاح المولدات والهرب، بينما يطاردهم لاعب خامس بدور القاتل. إصدار Nintendo الرسمي هو إصدار Switch، ولا توجد حالياً نسخة ترقية مستقلة لـ Switch 2 بحسب دعم Behaviour.
patch.description_short: مواجهات رعب 4 ضد 1 عبر الإنترنت بين ناجين وقاتل، مع اللعب المشترك والتقدم المشترك.
features: Cross-play with supported PC and console platforms
Distinct Killer powers and Survivor perks
fitFor: Players who enjoy competitive online horror
Players who like perk builds and live-service progression
notFitFor: Players without a stable internet connection and Nintendo Switch Online
Players looking for offline play or local split-screen
Players expecting a dedicated Switch 2 upgrade

gameplayPillars.title: Four Survivors
gameplayPillars.description: Repair generators, rescue teammates, and escape while managing limited information.

gameplayPillars.title: One Killer
gameplayPillars.description: Track, chase, down, and sacrifice Survivors using a distinct power.

gameplayPillars.title: Perks and progression
gameplayPillars.description: Build character loadouts and adapt tactics across changing Trials.

gameplayPillars.title: Cross-platform community
gameplayPillars.description: Nintendo Switch participates in official cross-play and cross-progression, with documented Switch restrictions.

patch.worldSummary: Trials take place inside the Entity’s Fog, where Survivors and Killers repeat unpredictable hunts across themed realms.

faq.q: Is this a native Nintendo Switch 2 edition?
faq.a: No. Behaviour states there are currently no plans for a Switch 2 upgrade; this catalogue entry is the Nintendo Switch version running through compatibility.

faq.q: Is an internet connection required?
faq.a: Yes. The game is online multiplayer and Nintendo lists Nintendo Switch Online as required.

faq.q: How many players are in a match?
faq.a: Up to five online players: four Survivors and one Killer.

faq.q: Does Nintendo Switch support cross-play?
faq.a: Yes, when platforms are on compatible game versions.

faq.q: Does Nintendo Switch support cross-progression?
faq.a: Yes through a Behaviour Account, with platform-specific restrictions for Auric Cells and DLC transfer direction.

official.title: Devil May Cry 5 Devil Hunter Edition

patch.title: Devil May Cry 5 Devil Hunter Edition
patch.titleEn: Devil May Cry 5 Devil Hunter Edition
patch.titleAr: ديفل ماي كراي 5 — إصدار ديفل هنتر
patch.description_ar: نسخة Nintendo Switch 2 الرسمية من لعبة الأكشن السريعة Devil May Cry 5. تقدم قتال السيوف والأسلحة النارية وشخصيات متعددة بأساليب مختلفة، وتؤكد Nintendo وCapcom تشغيلها بمعدل 60 إطاراً في الثانية في وضعي التلفاز والمحمول.
patch.description_short: أكشن سريع وأسلوب قتال استعراضي على Switch 2 بمعدل 60 FPS في وضعي التلفاز والمحمول.
patch.tagline: Devil May Cry 5 brings stylish action to Nintendo Switch 2.
features: 60 FPS in both TV and handheld modes
Multiple playable characters with distinct combat styles
Complete In-game Unlock Bundle available as DLC
fitFor: Players who enjoy technical character-action combat
Players who replay missions to improve style ranks
Players who want a portable 60 FPS Devil May Cry 5 release
notFitFor: Players looking for multiplayer or local co-op
Players who expect the Nintendo SKU to be titled Special Edition
Players who cannot download a Game-Key Card installation

gameplayPillars.title: Three distinct hunters
gameplayPillars.description: Dante, Nero, and V use different weapons, abilities, and combat systems.

gameplayPillars.title: Style-driven combat
gameplayPillars.description: Varied attacks and precise execution raise the style rank.

gameplayPillars.title: Demonic campaign
gameplayPillars.description: Story missions combine exploration, cinematic encounters, and large boss battles.

gameplayPillars.title: Portable performance
gameplayPillars.description: Nintendo and Capcom officially state 60 FPS in TV and handheld modes.

patch.worldSummary: Demon hunters converge on Red Grave City as a massive demonic invasion grows around the Qliphoth tree.

contents.label: Additional content included with this Nintendo Switch 2 edition

faq.q: Is this the Special Edition?
faq.a: The official Nintendo Switch 2 product title is Devil May Cry 5 Devil Hunter Edition; the catalogue has been corrected to that SKU identity.

faq.q: What frame rate does it support?
faq.a: Nintendo and Capcom state 60 FPS in both TV and handheld modes.

faq.q: What resolution does it use?
faq.a: The official sources reviewed do not publish exact rendering or output resolutions.

faq.q: When did it release?
faq.a: The digital version released June 23, 2026; Capcom lists the physical version for August 28, 2026.

faq.q: Is it multiplayer?
faq.a: Nintendo lists one player; this is a single-player action game.

patch.description_ar: رحلة نشأة Lara Croft من شابة قليلة الخبرة إلى ناجية صلبة على جزيرة خطرة. تجمع اللعبة بين الاستكشاف والتسلق والقتال وتطوير الأسلحة، ويضم إصدار Nintendo طور القصة واللعب الجماعي عبر الإنترنت حتى ثمانية لاعبين.
patch.description_short: مغامرة سينمائية تروي نشأة Lara Croft، مع استكشاف وقتال وطور جماعي عبر الإنترنت.
features: Cinematic origin story for Lara Croft
Online multiplayer for up to eight players
TressFX 1.0 update available on Nintendo Switch 2
fitFor: Players who enjoy cinematic action-adventure campaigns
Fans of exploration, traversal, and survival combat
Players who also want the included online multiplayer modes
notFitFor: Younger players due to the Mature rating
Players seeking local co-op or split-screen
Players expecting officially published resolution and FPS specifications

gameplayPillars.title: Survival and exploration
gameplayPillars.description: Cross dangerous terrain, solve environmental challenges, and search the island.

gameplayPillars.title: Traversal
gameplayPillars.description: Climbing tools and movement abilities open new routes.

gameplayPillars.title: Combat and upgrades
gameplayPillars.description: Improve weapons and equipment while facing human and supernatural threats.

gameplayPillars.title: Definitive presentation
gameplayPillars.description: This release presents the rebuilt Definitive Edition and later received TressFX 1.0 on Switch 2.

patch.worldSummary: Lara is stranded on Yamatai, an island shaped by violent storms, hostile scavengers, ancient ruins, and a deadly secret.

faq.q: When did this Nintendo release launch?
faq.a: Nintendo lists November 18, 2025.

faq.q: Is online multiplayer included?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo lists online play for up to eight players and Nintendo Switch Online is required for online features.

faq.q: Does it run on Nintendo Switch 2?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo lists it as supported with behavior consistent with Switch.

faq.q: Is there a Switch 2 enhancement?
faq.a: Aspyr added TressFX 1.0 on May 20, 2026 and states it is out on Nintendo Switch 2.

faq.q: What are the official resolution and FPS values?
faq.a: The reviewed Nintendo and Aspyr sources do not publish exact verified figures, so none are inferred.

features: Watercolor backgrounds and original jazz recordings
The Delicious Last Course expansion available separately
fitFor: Players who enjoy difficult pattern-based boss fights
Players who value hand-crafted art and music
Two players looking for same-system local co-op

faq.q: Does Cuphead support co-op on Nintendo Switch?
faq.a: Yes. Studio MDHR and Nintendo confirm local co-op for two players on the same system.

faq.q: Does it support online co-op?
faq.a: No official online multiplayer mode is listed for this Nintendo Switch release.

faq.q: Is the screen split in co-op?
faq.a: No. Both players share the same game view; this is local co-op, not split-screen.

faq.q: Is The Delicious Last Course included in the base game?
faq.a: It is a separate DLC and requires the original Cuphead game.

faq.q: Does it work on Nintendo Switch 2?
faq.a: Nintendo lists it as supported with behavior consistent with Nintendo Switch.
